purpose: Test one new payoff-aware setup-selection hypothesis for the unchanged 5-day trend-acceleration primary. Predict continuous standalone setup net bps instead of binary win/loss.

provenance.generated_from: Sprint 12 diagnostic lesson that binary classification may not align with payoff magnitude

data.survivorship_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; historical results do not remove survivorship risk.

execution.execution: next UTC daily open after completed signal day
execution.rebalance: daily including transitions to and from cash

primary_setup.score: sum of completed close-to-close returns t-4..t minus sum t-9..t-5
primary_setup.direction: long highest two scores and short lowest two
primary_setup.state_gate: BTC Wilder ADX14 >= 25 at completed signal close
primary_setup.weighting: 25% absolute weight in each of four selected legs

payoff_label.target: continuous standalone next-open to next-open net bps of the proposed primary setup
payoff_label.costs: realized funding plus forced cash-to-position-to-cash 10 bps per side

walk_forward_model.refit: every eligible primary setup using the latest 80 strictly prior labeled primary setups

controls.ungated_parent: take every eligible primary setup unchanged
controls.same_payoff_meta_decisions_reversed_prim: same TRADE/PASS decisions applied to reversed primary ranking
controls.anti_meta_diagnostic: diagnostic only: take setups whose predicted standalone net bps is below zero

d0_research_candidate_gate.selection: Single frozen payoff model and zero-net-bps decision threshold. No post-result substitution.

evidence_boundary.research_candidate_means: deserves freeze and hostile validation, not established edge
evidence_boundary.required_path_after_D0: candidate freeze -> independent reproduction -> D2 source replication -> D3 non-overlapping temporal -> D4 prospective shadow
